meta.title: Videogames — Erveca Studio
meta.desc: Almazuela Picross and Erveca: the videogames of Erveca Studio, inspired by the culture, landscape and craftsmanship of La Rioja.
games.label: Our titles
games.title: Three games, one shared root
games.lead: Erveca, our flagship project, Goddess of the skies and Almazuela Picross: games built around the way of playing of the first one and the same territory: Cameros, La Rioja.
games.goddess.alt: Screenshot of Goddess of the Skies
games.goddess.label: Coming soon
games.goddess.p1: Our upcoming title, where we keep the calm and the culture. You will explore islands inspired by the architecture of the villages of Cameros and solve logic puzzles using the environment.
games.goddess.p2: It will include 20 starting islands with puzzles solved using four abilities granted by the goddesses of Erveca, plus 4 puzzles based on searching for tiles. There will also be a camp you can decorate with the treasures found by Silvia, the protagonist, inspired by traditional and popular Riojan culture.
games.picross.label: Available now
games.picross.p1: A cozy nonogram game inspired by La Rioja's textile tradition. Solve picross puzzles to unlock fabric scraps and, once you have them all, join them into a complete almazuela: a traditional textile piece made of scraps sewn together.
games.picross.p2: The game includes 31 real almazuelas lent by the artisans of the Almazuela Festival of Pradillo, plus a special almazuela designed by the studio's fan community. 32 levels, each with several nonograms and an extra puzzle, in a vector art style designed for relaxed play with no time pressure.
games.erveca.label: In development · itch.io
games.erveca.p1: Our flagship project: an adventure role-playing game with a medieval fantasy look, set in the Cameros region of La Rioja. The game travels through real villages of the area —Pradillo, Ortigosa, El Rasillo— reinventing the way to connect young people with rural life.
games.erveca.p2: Erveca is supported by the Department of Culture of the Government of La Rioja and is available on itch.io to follow its development. The nonograms that later became Almazuela Picross originally started as minigames within this project.
